regime_context: The detector shows a broad rotation (50% of themes eligible) with no single dominant narrative and low absorption (0.31), meaning leadership is contested rather than concentrated. Oil & Gas Producers leads the rank, but the backtest verdict confirms cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0 (focus lens only); the only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate, which is active here (gate_helps: true) — so the useful signal is mostly about staying with trends that are still above their trend gate, not about prediction.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners is the closest challenger to Oil & Gas (score 1.11 vs 1.612) but with durability_bar of only 0.48 and breadth of 0.267 — watching whether breadth expands above 0.5 on XGD.TO over the next 10 trading days; that would mark a confirmed strengthening handoff worth monitoring, not a call to rotate.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is the only theme combining trend eligibility with the broadest, most durable internally consistent move (durability_bar 0.68, breadth 0.786) — the two legs that the backtest says carry any staying-power signal. Rank is high, but I treat that as attention focus, not alpha; the thesis is that the trend stays intact and volatility stays controlled while above the absolute-trend gate.
evidence: breadth: 0.786 — widest participation of eligible themes
crowded: true — a caution, not a buy trigger; reflexivity means do not fade the leader
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=1.04) combined with a 'mixed' hurst_tag suggests the move is mature and could chop sideways or gap down on any crude/energy sentiment shock; breadth alone does not protect against a sector-wide de-rate.

theses.thesis: Technology is eligible (trend gate passed) but shows the worst combination of textures: crowded (z=1.25, the highest in the set), a 'mixed' hurst_tag, and high breadth (0.7) but with the lowest durability_bar of the eligible scorable names at 0.69 alongside falling rank. This is a size-down / stay-out pattern, not a fade call.
evidence: crowding_z: 1.25 — highest crowding flag in the eligible set
hurst_tag: mixed — no persistent trend character
theses.dissent: High breadth (0.7) means many names are participating — if a fresh catalyst lifts the whole sector, the crowding flag could prove a false caution and the theme could re-accelerate.
